visualContract.layoutPolicy: Pagination binds all seven actual exports and explicitly imports its real Button styling dependency. Native 32px square page actions and 2px gap are retained; destination wording does not become fixed previous/next widths. The selected pinned Button primitive renders these anchors with role=button and tabindex=0 because nativeButton=false, and intentionally supplies Space activation while Enter uses native href activation. The reference faithfully describes page actions backed by href, rather than incorrectly claiming plain link roles or Enter-only behavior. isActive supplies aria-current=page, data-active and the source outline variant; it does not change a stored page index. Previous/Next text and accessible names are caller-localizable; the reference follows the source hide/show text recipe at explicit 40rem. Unavailable boundary actions are omitted, not fake-disabled anchors. Ellipsis remains hidden and does not imply a menu. All page computation, routing/fetching and isActive updates remain caller-owned.
